body:
Founder ran the nginx rewrite fix (sudo sed one-liner) live on iam.okemily.com and ran ~/wotan-deploy.sh. Verified end-to-end: iam.okemily.com now returns a clean 200 with the real IDUNA login page (was a mangled 307 double-query-string redirect before the fix). Deployed wotan.okemily.com/store.html has zero password fields and a working 'Sign in with IDUNA' link building the correct redirect_uri. Closes the 'no password in the webpage on WOTAN, IDUNA becomes the SSO' founder directive.

⚓ ☃
title: WOTAN store.html deployed live with working IDUNA SSO (iam.okemily.com nginx fix confirmed live)
